hook: Murati is an engineer who worked in product roles at Tesla and Leap Motion before joining OpenAI in 2018, where she became chief technology officer in 2022 and briefly served as interim CEO in November 2023. She left OpenAI in 2024 and in February 2025 launched Thinking Machines Lab, an AI research and product company she leads as co-founder and chief executive, with John Schulman as co-founder and chief scientist. The company has since released the Tinker fine-tuning service and the open-weights Inkling model.

quick_facts: Born in Vlore, Albania, she earned an AB from Colby College and a BE in engineering from Dartmouth's Thayer School of Engineering in 2012.
Worked as a product manager on the Tesla Model X from 2013 to 2016, then led product and engineering at Leap Motion until 2018.
Joined OpenAI in 2018 and became its chief technology officer in May 2022.
Was named OpenAI's interim CEO on November 17, 2023, after the board removed Sam Altman.
Received an honorary Doctor of Science from Dartmouth on June 9, 2024.
Is identified as co-founder and CEO of Thinking Machines Lab in NVIDIA's partnership announcement of March 10, 2026.

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, OpenAI
achievements.impact: Oversaw research, product development and deployment at OpenAI as CTO from May 2022 until she left in 2024.

achievements.title: Interim Chief Executive Officer, OpenAI
achievements.impact: Named interim CEO by OpenAI's board on November 17, 2023, during the leadership crisis that followed Sam Altman's removal.

achievements.title: Founder, Thinking Machines Lab
achievements.impact: Launched the company publicly on February 18, 2025, as a public benefit corporation, and raised a $2 billion seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz in July 2025.

achievements.title: Tinker and Inkling
achievements.impact: Thinking Machines announced Tinker, a service for fine-tuning models, on October 1, 2025, and released Inkling, an open-weights multimodal model available for fine-tuning on Tinker, on July 15, 2026.

achievements.title: NVIDIA partnership
achievements.impact: In March 2026 the company agreed a multiyear partnership with NVIDIA to deploy at least one gigawatt of Vera Rubin systems, alongside a significant NVIDIA investment.

source_basis: This profile was written mainly from the Wikipedia article on Mira Murati, retrieved 2026-10-22, with awards, dates and current role checked against NVIDIA's March 2026 partnership announcement, Thinking Machines Lab's own site and Dartmouth's 2024 honorary degree announcement.
